risks.risk: Rust/corrosion visible near the lower front area may indicate water ingress or drainage/door seal issues; this can lead to leaks or recurring problems even if it runs briefly.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the rust area plus a side/under view showing the bottom edge, door gasket condition, and any wetness; also show the drain hose connection area.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used with possible moisture exposure (worst case: treat as higher risk of future leaks/maintenance).

risks.risk: “Tested yesterday” can’t be validated remotely without seeing the machine run through a full cycle and spin without errors.
risks.proof: Video of a full wash cycle (wash + rinse + spin) with the display visible and no error codes; include a short spin-only test.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed perfect (worst case: assume minor faults possible until proven).

risks.risk: Exact model/serial not readable, so warranty/parts compatibility and true age can’t be confirmed.
risks.proof: Photo of the rating plate/serial label showing model number and serial.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst-case for a generic 7kg LG DirectDrive used unit without warranty confirmation.

risks.risk: Possible prior repairs/tampering can’t be ruled out from the front photo.
risks.proof: Photo of the back panel (cover intact, any service stickers) and a clear shot of the motor area without disassembly.
risks.if_unproven: Price as unknown service history (worst case: standard used condition, not “barely used”).

proof_requests: Send a short video of a complete wash cycle with the display visible (no error codes) and a spin-only test.
Send a clear photo of the rating plate/serial label (model number + serial).
Send close-ups of the rust/corrosion area and the door gasket/seal, plus a side/bottom edge photo.
Send a photo of the back panel/motor area to confirm no recent opening/repairs.
response.reason: The seller’s new message is only a verbal claim; without a wash-cycle video and the rating-plate photo, the rust risk and “no fault” status can’t be verified, so pricing confidently isn’t possible yet.
